title: Good cushion but slides around and overpriced
text: Good cushion but slides around and overpriced. This half moon mat is soft with good cushion but does not stay put; it slides around and is extrémely overpriced for $30.

description: The BioPEDIC Memory Foam Bath Mat is the perfect addition to your bathroom for cushion from a cold floor. This bath mat features 3/4" of memory foam for a plush. This mat aslo features a decorative bubble weave design, which will add style to your space and is machine washable. The integrated Gripwell anti-skid technology on the bottom of this mat helps ensure it stays in place. With the wash ability features, treatment, and anti-skid technology, this mat is also perfect for kitchen use. Available colors are linen and grey and sizes include 17" x 24", 40" Half Round / Sink Mat, and a 24" x 58" runner.
